user_story: As a staff member, I want to confirm a booking so that the guest knows their reservation is secured.

positive.title: Confirm a valid booking successfully
steps: Step 1: Login as a staff member.
Step 2: Navigate to the bookings section.
Step 4: Click on the 'Confirm Booking' button.
Step 5: Verify the confirmation message is displayed.
positive.expected_result: The system confirms the booking, and the guest receives a confirmation notification.

negative.title: Attempt to confirm an already confirmed booking
steps: Step 1: Login as a staff member.
Step 2: Navigate to the bookings section.
Step 3: Select a booking that is already confirmed.
Step 4: Click on the 'Confirm Booking' button.
negative.expected_result: The system shows an error message indicating the booking is already confirmed.

edge.title: Confirm a booking with special characters in the guest name
steps: Step 1: Login as a staff member.
Step 2: Navigate to the bookings section.
Step 3: Select a booking with special characters in the guest name.
Step 4: Click on the 'Confirm Booking' button.
Step 5: Verify the confirmation message is displayed.
edge.expected_result: The system confirms the booking successfully with no issues related to special characters.
